findings.claim: Hand-rolled --set parser (replacing helm strvals) drops values for intermediate array indices and panics on nested array indices.
findings.proposedFix: In setValueAtPath, persist grown slices back into their parent at every level (closure-based set-back), not only for the last segment.
findings.observed: storages[0].name=data -> storages=[] (dropped); matrix[0][1]=x -> panic: index out of range [0] with length 0

findings.claim: Single-node PyTorch submit that requests GPUs fails validation: master-only nils Worker, then ApplyOverrides.ensureWorker() resurrects Worker{Replicas:0}.
findings.proposedFix: Make single-node PyTorch keep master-only semantics through overrides (route resource flags to Master when Worker is nil), or have ensureWorker default Replicas=1. Add an end-to-end submit->override->validate test.

findings.claim: ResolveMPIVersion re-wraps ErrCRDNotFound as a bare string, so errors.Is(err, ErrCRDNotFound) is false at the layer callers use to distinguish 'operator not installed'.
findings.proposedFix: return fmt.Errorf("MPIJob CRD not found in cluster: %w", ErrCRDNotFound)
findings.observed: errors.Is == false; err="MPIJob CRD not found in cluster"

findings.claim: MPIProvider.GetLogPodSelector uses training.kubeflow.org/replica-type=launcher; the standalone mpi-operator (v2beta1) labels pods with training.kubeflow.org/job-role. The same PR defines constants.LabelJobRole but never uses it.
findings.requiresConfirmation: Confirm the deployed mpi-operator's pod label (job-role vs replica-type) for the MPIJob apiVersion arena targets. If job-role: invert this canary to a contract test and switch the selector.

findings.claim: ApplyOverrides with tensorboard=false materializes a non-nil TensorBoardConfig{Enabled:false}. NOT reachable via current CLI (buildSubmitFlags omits the key when false); API-level footgun only.
findings.proposedFix: Only allocate TensorBoardConfig when enabling (v==true) or when logdir/image present.

findings.claim: setInt guard (n>0) prevents overriding priority to 0 or negative; k8s priority is signed. Also CLI-gated today.
findings.proposedFix: Track flag-changed explicitly (cobra Changed) instead of value>0 heuristics, at least for signed fields like priority.

findings.claim: e2e suite lacks //go:build v2e2e, so plain `go test ./...` compiles and runs the cluster-dependent suite and hard-fails in BeforeSuite.
tests: matrix: go test ./... at pr-1483 (results/test-1483 fails only test/e2e)
findings.proposedFix: Add //go:build v2e2e to every file in test/e2e/ (matching the Makefile's -tags v2e2e).
findings.observed: 12 files under test/e2e lack the tag; `go test ./...` -> FAIL test/e2e BeforeSuite 'CRD directory not found'

findings.claim: `delete -f` resolves namespace as resolveNS("") (drops YAML namespace) while `run` uses resolveNS(t.Namespace) — destructive-op targeting the wrong namespace.
findings.proposedFix: delete.go: ns := resolveNS(t.Namespace) to match run.go.

findings.claim: Unanchored `arena-v2` .gitignore pattern ignores the cmd/arena-v2/ source directory, not just the built binary.
findings.proposedFix: Anchor to /arena-v2 (bin/arena-v2 is already covered by bin/).
findings.observed: git check-ignore matches cmd/arena-v2 and cmd/arena-v2/main.go
